page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top, centred over the text. One text column of running prose below it, with no margin notes. Signature "Dd 5" and catchword "de-" at the foot.

main_text.p: non probantur, quæ multa in esse ex codicum varietate colligebamus, librariorum certè incuria, sed ipsa tantùm interpretis versio probatur, ubi constiterit aut ex codicum omnium consensione, aut Ecclesiæ auctoritate locum aliquem ab illo ita esse conversum; addo tamen, nec verbis quidem illis ita esse probatam nostram editionem, ut eadem magis proprie aut magis aperte exprimi posse, nonnullis locis negent.Hanc Concilii mente fuisse probat testimonio Jacobi Laines Societatis Jesu Præpositi Generalis, qui Concilio interfuit, & paulo post Gallos Italos, atque Germanos Scriptores, qui libris de Theologia editis non dubitabant sæpe editionis vulgatæ vitia accusare, & nostri interpretis oscitantiam[?]; grave est universos quasi impios & de Religione male sentientes criminari, præsertim cum validis argumentis eorum sententia fulciatur, &c. Multa superiori[?] in Hebraicis & Græcis codicibus vitia esse ostendimus, multa mendacia in rebus minutis, eorum pars aliqua non exigua in nostra editione Vulgata extat.Hoc postea multis exemplis de-

page.notes: The first word of the page continues from the previous page. The printed running head is "Card. BABERINO." and the page number reads "611", though the numeral is worn, so it is marked [?]. The word "oscitantiam" and "superiori" are worn in the scan and are marked [?]. "Laines" is printed with no space before "Societatis", and is kept as printed. Catchword "de-" is the start of the next page.
